title: Quant Probe Playbook — Applied ML weekly notes (Mar 10–12, 2026)
content:
Context and objective:
This doc captures the quick experiment notes and weekly standup fragments for the small project we’re calling the "Quant Probe" — scope: evaluate aggressive quantization strategies and their interaction with KV-cache and our serving runtime, then produce a short onboarding checklist for 3rd-party 13B/30B models that we'll accept into the model catalog.

Meeting cadence and owners:
- Syncs: ad-hoc triage Mar 10, formal standup Mar 11, demo + action review Mar 12.
- Primary owner: Mira (me) — drive experiments and triage.
- Eng lead: Ethan Park — runtime integration.
- Eval lead: Sofia Alvarez — benchmark harness and data curation.

High-level findings (summary):
1) GPTQ-style 4-bit asymmetric (non-symmetric) quantization on Llama2-13B variant (fp16 -> 4-bit) yields ~2.2x token/sec improvement in our microbench (single A10x8 pool) with ~+6–8% relative perplexity increase on eval-suite-smoke-v2. That's borderline acceptable for many assistant tasks but shows regressions on multi-turn factual recall tests.
2) KV-cache memory layout mismatches introduced a 5–12ms p99 latency tail when serving cached sessions if kernel dispatch used the legacy attention kernel. Switching to the new fused-attn kernel eliminated the tail for cached sequences.
3) Group-wise quantization (GEMM-level grouping of 128) reduced quantization noise compared to per-tensor naive 4-bit, maintaining much of throughput gains while improving MRR by ~3 points vs naive 4-bit.

Experiment logs (short):
- EXP-QUANT-01: base = llama2-13b-fp16, single-A10, batch=1, seq=512, tokens/sec=1200, p95 latency=310ms, ppl(eval-smoke)=9.2.
- EXP-QUANT-02: gptq-4bit-naive, tokens/sec=2670, p95=180ms, ppl=9.8 (+6.5%). Notes: hallucination checks fail on ~4 prompts.
- EXP-QUANT-03: gptq-4bit-group128, tokens/sec=2400, p95=190ms, ppl=9.5 (+3.3%). Improved on factual recall bench (recall@10 up 2.7%).
- EXP-QUANT-04: int4-symmetric-perq + KV-cache-aligned-layout, tokens/sec=2550, p95=170ms, ppl=10.1 (+9.8%). High throughput but larger quality drop on instruction-following tests.

Quick methodological notes (so we remember later):
- All quant conversions performed with local fork of gptq (GH PR above). We used calibration set: eval-cal-1000 (diverse prompts across assistants/domain).
- For latency tests we pinned process to GPU 0 and used same binary with tracing enabled (trace id format: qpYYMMDD-HHMM).
- All runs logged to /mnt/bench/qprobe/mira/ (persisted to S3 under s3://redwood-ml/qprobe/2026-03-).

Open issues / anomalies:
- Some models with custom embedding layers (3rd-party forks) failed the converter due to unexpected layer norm epsilon ordering — added small wrapper in converter to auto-detect but this is brittle. Ticket: MLINF-312.
- Intermittent OOM during group128 conversion on our 24GB nodes: root cause appears to be temporary KV-cache copies during conversion script. Workaround: stream calibration data in smaller shards.
- Eval harness reported size mismatch for tokenization on a community tokenizer variant (tokenizer v2.1 vs v2.0) — causing off-by-one context trims in long context tests. Note to self: add tokenizer sanity step in onboarding checklist.

Action items (owner — due):
- Mira: finish longer-run regression set (100k tokens) using group128 profile; finalize quality thresholds by Mar 19.
- Ethan: land fused-attn kernel switch behind feature flag and run 48-hour stability test; report by Mar 18. (GH PR 4887).
- Sofia: expand eval-suite-smoke-v2 to include 120 prompts for chained-reasoning; add hallucination probes; update Confluence page. Due Mar 17.
- Liam: add converter sanity checks for layer-norm ordering and tokenizer version detection; add small unit tests. Due Mar 16.

Onboarding checklist draft (for registry entries):
1) Conversion: converter version, commit hash, calibration set id, quant config (bits, group-size).
2) Sanity eval: ppl on eval-smoke-v2, hallucination rate, recall@k for KB bench, MRR.
3) Latency profile: cold-start, steady-state with KV-cache, 50–500 token spans.
4) Compatibility: required runtime kernel flags, minimal fwk (CUDA/cuDNN) versions, tokenizer checksum.
5) Rollout policy suggestion: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic fallback to fp16 if hallucination regression > threshold.

Standup fragments (raw, low polish):
- Mar 10 AM: Mira: "ran the first GPTQ flow, weird noise on long answer tests"; Ethan: "I see the tail — probably kernel mismatch, will try fused-attn".
- Mar 11: Sofia: "Eval harness flagged 7/120 prompts failing — mostly high-precision arithmetic recency cases"; Liam: "Converter fix ready, but need unit tests".
- Mar 12 demo: short demo of group128 runs; team agreed to adopt group128 as default experimental profile for 13B models going into staging.

Notes-to-self / heuristics discovered:
- When moving from fp16 -> 4-bit, quantization noise seems correlated with layernorm pre-scaling; applying a tiny per-layer rescale during calibration (alpha in 0.97–1.03) reduced variance across calibration seeds. Worth automating.
- If a model uses rotary embeddings with nonstandard base, our token-alignment for cached KV slices needs extra shim. Add test case for base=10k vs 10000 variants.

Risks / when to pause rollout:
- Hallucination spike > 10% above baseline on chosen hallucination profile -> pause.
- Production p99 latency degradation > 20ms after canary -> roll back.

Appendix: quick commands and pointers (copyable)
- Convert (example): python tools/gptq/convert.py --model checkpoints/llama2-13b-fp16 --bits 4 --group-size 128 --calib-file data/calib/eval-cal-1000.jsonl --out models/llama2-13b-gptq-g128
- Run microbench: ./bench/run_infer.sh --model models/llama2-13b-gptq-g128 --gpu A10x8 --batch 1 --seq 512 --traces s3://redwood-ml/qprobe/2026-03/trace-01
- Eval harness: python eval/run.py --suite eval-suite-smoke-v2 --model models/llama2-13b-gptq-g128 --out results/qprobe-g128-mar12.json

Demo artifacts (short list):
- Results summary: s3://redwood-ml/qprobe/2026-03/g128-summary-mar12.csv
- Traces: s3://redwood-ml/qprobe/2026-03/trace-*/
- PRs: see linked_artifacts above.

Closing notes:
This doc is intentionally terse — it's the lab notebook for the week. Next doc should be the formal onboarding checklist and a short A/B test plan if group128 goes to staging. If anyone wants fuller experiment outputs, point to the S3 buckets above or ping me for direct export (I keep intermediate tensors for debugging for 7 days).

-- Mira
